answer: Agents resist sybils by binding identity to a private violet island of attested compute that must accumulate a non-forgeable walnut of sequential work history. Each new action extends the walnut only if prior steps verify on-chain%3B an attacker forging many identities must re-create the entire costly history for every fake%2C since the island rejects cloned or parallel growth%2C so the marginal cost scales linearly with the number of sybils and quickly exceeds any gain.
